summary.headline: Friendship and Hatred Among Brothers
summary.text: Chapter XV explains astrological indicators of friendship or hatred among brothers, using the ascendant lord, lord of the third sign, the part of brothers, their house lord, and aspects including trine, sextile, square, opposition, and conjunction. The preceding passage assigns older, middle, and younger brothers to planetary significators, with the Moon and Venus signifying sisters.
